instruction: Candid medium shot of a man in a gray suit (R1) with his back to the camera and a woman in a black dress (R2) facing him. They embrace while dancing tango against a plain white background under soft, diffused indoor light.
elements: R1 is the tango partner with his back to the camera while facing R2
R2 is the tango partner facing R1 rather than having her back to the camera
R1 and R2 are in a close tango dance contact with each other
R2 faces toward R1 during the dance pose
the dancers are against a plain white background

questions.q: Is R1 the tango dancer with his back to the camera while R2 faces him, rather than R2 being the dancer with his or her back to the camera?
questions.element: R1 is the back-to-camera partner and R2 is the facing partner
